name: Arrowdle
summary: Arrowdle is a daily logic puzzle about arrows. Tap an arrow and it slides off the board along its own path; if another arrow is in the way, it crashes and you lose a heart. Every day there is one new board, the same for every player in the world, with a single try and a shareable, spoiler-free result. Endless procedurally generated levels add new mechanics every few levels: frozen arrows, locks and keys, deflectors, twin arrows, fog and bombs, plus a time attack mode with weekly leaderboards. Free to play with ads and an optional one-time Premium purchase.
